subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding fuse wire?

options.text: It has a low melting point and low conductivity.
It has a high melting point and low conductivity.
It has a low melting point and high conductivity.
It has a high melting point and high conductivity.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It has a low melting point and high conductivity. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Fuse wire** is made of a material with a low melting point and **high conductivity.**
 
• If it is inserted into an electric circuit, it will not allow excess electricity to flow throw it.
 
• when the current exceeds its limit, the fuse wire gets heated, melts, and breaks the circuit.
 
• It is made of an alloy tin(Sn) and leads (Pb).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric Current**

 
 
• Electric current is the rate of flow of an electric charge.
 
• it flows from positive to negative.
 
 
 
• **Magnetic effect of electricity**
 
 
• It is the phenomenon by which a magnetic field is produced by an Electric current.
